title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the $$'oh_{tickets'}$$ column. This column shows the number of office hours tickets each staff member resolved. We need to find the staff member with the highest number in this column.

title: Sorting the DataFrame
text: To find the staff member with the highest $$'oh_{tickets'}$$, consider sorting the DataFrame by this column in descending order. This will bring the highest value to the top.

title: Selecting the Top Row
